svg.title: DISTANCE - Antonio Chapinal
svg.desc: An interactive 3D space exploration experience and tactical star map built with Three.js. Fly across eight detailed planetary systems and orbiting moons representing Antonio Chapinal's Microsoft cloud, AI Foundry, Fabric, AKS, SRE, Arc and Quantum repositories.
svg.text: FOUNDRY · FABRIC · Q# · AKS · SRE · ARC · SQL · COPILOT
Fly the 3D star map. Scan every Microsoft stack.
